66671d82c3c9c18c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المحايد مهندسون استشاريون عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف الهندسي على المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءاً من دراسة الموقع وإعداد التصاميم، وصولاً إلى متابعة التنفيذ وضمان مطابقة المواصفات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة واسعة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بشكل دقيق. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقته للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، مع توضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة عميقة بالدراسات الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية واختبارات فحص التربة. إتقان إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات وجداول الكميات. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع وضمان الجودة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات الهندسية المعقدة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع فرق العمل المختلفة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل الهندسي. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المحايد مهندسون استشاريون بالدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشروع. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية في عملية التوظيف.

664868764af15ac5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي عن فني صيدلة للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم العمليات الصيدلانية وضمان جودة الأدوية والمستحضرات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمتخصصين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والأمصال والسموم والمواد الصيدلانية، بما في ذلك أشكالها وأنواعها. تنفيذ خطة تصنيع الأدوية والمستحضرات الصيدلانية. تحديد الكميات المعيارية المعتمدة وإعداد البرنامج التنفيذي لإنتاج الأدوية بالتنسيق المباشر مع الصيدلي المشرف. تحضير المواد اللازمة لإنتاج الأدوية الصلبة والسائلة وفقاً للكميات المطلوبة. تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والأدوات المستخدمة في عمليات إنتاج الأدوية. متابعة إنتاج الأدوية والمستحضرات، وأخذ عينات من الدواء المنتج لتحويلها إلى المختبر ومطابقة المواصفات. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة أو تصنيع الأدوية. فهم جيد لمواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والمواد الصيدلانية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالبرامج التنفيذية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيدلة ضمن فريق مجمع عيادات الخزان الطبي في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة مهنية تركز على الجودة والالتزام بالمعايير الصيدلانية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يوفر فرصة للتطور المهني المستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات على تقديم طلباتهم.

Manage the full sales cycle, encompassing first contact, pitching, contract negotiation, and closing. Build and maintain long-term partnerships with hospitals, clinics, and medical centers. 66881ee488f326ee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل الخاصة بالصيانة، والإشراف على تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة وتطوير فريق الصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الشامل للصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تصميم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج عمل فعالة. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية لتوجيه وتقييم فرق العمل. القدرة على تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير مهارات الفريق. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصيانة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في عمليات الصيانة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل الميداني والإشراف المباشر على المهام. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الصيانة والتشغيل. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

665705f165a6252e.description: About Eltizam Eltizam is an insurance technology platform focused on delivering high-quality services at competitive prices efficiently. The company employs a customer-centric approach, customizing insurance coverage to meet individual needs. Eltizam is an early adopter of artificial intelligence technologies in the Saudi market, utilizing advanced tools to enhance efficiency and personalization. The team is dedicated to innovation and continuous improvement to provide clients with optimal offers and digital experiences. The Role of AI Native Backend Engineer (.NET) Eltizam is seeking an AI Native Backend Engineer (.NET) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 3-5 years of experience. The role involves developing and maintaining backend systems crucial for the company's insurance technology platform, with a focus on AI-driven solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage insurer partner integrations from sandbox environments to go-live, including building REST or SOAP adapters to request quotes, map coverage, submit policies for issuance, and retrieve policy documents. Integrate payment gateways for checkout and refunds, verify signed callbacks, update payment statuses, trigger policy issuance, and reconcile settlements. Implement customer identity features such as registration, sign-in, OTP verification, and session renewal, while enforcing roles and resource-level access across customer accounts and policy APIs. Develop backend features including business rules, **** Core endpoints, MySQL migrations, RabbitMQ consumers, and background jobs. Optimize queries and Redis caching to manage increasing traffic. Balance feature releases, partner onboarding, and production issues, resolving blockers directly with partner engineers and overseeing each change through rollout. Required Technical Skills and Tools Proficiency in C# and **** Core (.NET 8/10). Experience with MySQL HeatWave for database management. Familiarity with RabbitMQ for message queuing. Knowledge of Redis for caching solutions. Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD. Familiarity with Seq for logging and monitoring. Experience and Location Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in backend engineering. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in contributing to an innovative insurance technology platform, we encourage you to apply.

665d12c76fcff48b.description: About the Role PE Global Healthcare is seeking an experienced Consultant General Pediatrician to join a reputable healthcare facility in Al Ahsa, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing high-quality, patient-centred care to paediatric patients, managing a wide range of childhood illnesses, and delivering preventative healthcare services. Key Responsibilities Provide comprehensive clinical care and consultations to paediatric inpatients and outpatients. Diagnose, manage, and treat a wide range of paediatric conditions. Perform diagnostic and therapeutic procedures within the scope of clinical privileges. Maintain accurate and timely medical records and documentation. Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary healthcare teams. Participate in on-call duties and respond to emergency cases when required. Contribute to clinical meetings, training, education, and quality improvement initiatives. Support the development and implementation of clinical guidelines and best practices. 666a68f0c2183292.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والادارة عن مهندس إلكترونيات للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومخصص للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة، حيث يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. يركز الدور على دعم العمليات التشغيلية والإدارية المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب، بالإضافة إلى إجراء التشغيل التجريبي والضبط. تدريب المستخدمين على تشغيل الأجهزة الإلكترونية لضمان الاستخدام الأمثل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إجراء الفحوص اللازمة بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة الأداء وفعاليته. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الإلكترونية بما يتوافق مع تعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الإلكترونيات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وعرضها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال هندسة الإلكترونيات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق الإرشادات الفنية لتركيب وصيانة الأجهزة. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال وإيجاد الحلول الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الإلكترونيات ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة سمامة للتشغيل والادارة بمدينة بريدة، القصيم. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام الصيانة والتركيب والتدريب في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة سمامة للتشغيل والادارة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

66a0127dc3123591.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات عن أخصائي تغذية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية وضع برامج التغذية والحمية الغذائية للمرضى والأصحاء، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية وحفظها. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة القيم الغذائية والسعرات الحرارية لمختلف أنواع الأغذية، وتقدير الاحتياجات الفردية من السعرات الحرارية. تحليل برامج الحمية الغذائية المتنوعة، واختيار أو إعداد برامج حمية غذائية للأفراد الأصحاء بناءً على احتياجاتهم الغذائية والحرارية. إعداد برامج تغذية للمرضى داخل المستشفيات، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار توصيات الطبيب المعالج والاحتياجات الغذائية للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال تنفيذ جميع أعمال التغذية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التغذية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الغذائية وتقدير الاحتياجات الفردية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة أفراس للتجارة والمقاولات. نوع التوظيف دوام كامل. الراتب الراتب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

66c60786a7722002.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking an Engineer, OEx Project Control & Reporting to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time position is a critical governance role within the OpEx department, responsible for ensuring the integrity of project data and transforming raw industrial data into strategic intelligence for executive decision-making. The role requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Role Context and Purpose Reporting to the Head of PMO, this position serves as the financial and analytical conscience of the department. The Engineer, OEx Project Control & Reporting ensures that all projects are financially viable, accurately tracked, and transparently reported, supporting informed decisions by executive leadership. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and maintenance of real-time digital dashboards (OEx "Control Towers") to monitor portfolio health across all OEx departments. Consolidate complex datasets to produce weekly and monthly "Industrial Performance Governance" reports for the COEO and Executive Leadership. Collaborate with Project Managers to conduct pre-gate cost-benefit analyses and ROI simulations to ensure project viability and strategic alignment. Systematically track project progress, scope compliance, and actual spending (CAPEX/OPEX) against baselines, identifying fiscal variances. Collaborate with Project Managers to engineer data-driven mitigation plans for cost overruns and schedule slippages (SPI/CPI intervention). Enforce project accounting protocols, ensuring Project Managers utilize unified financial templates and standardized KPIs. Serve as the internal auditor for the Continuous Improvement pipeline, ensuring projects are properly triggered, prioritized, and executed within the OEx framework. Provide data-driven insights into project risks, translating technical bottlenecks and schedule delays into "Financial Impact" projections. Execute post-implementation audits to verify that completed projects delivered promised industrial performance and technical ROI. Support research and deployment of advanced project management tools (AI-analytics, automated forecasting) to enhance OEx execution precision. Contribute to the "Lessons Learned" repository, structuring technical insights for future industrialization cycles. 66e4085345587a46.description: The Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Consultant is responsible for investigating cybersecurity incidents, conducting digital forensic examinations, and supporting the containment, eradication, and recovery of security threats across customer environments. The role provides specialist technical expertise in incident investigation, evidence preservation, compromise assessments, and advanced threat analysis. Requirements: Digital Forensics & Incident Investigation Conduct digital forensic investigations across endpoints, servers, networks, and cloud environments to identify evidence of malicious activity and security compromise. Acquire, preserve, and analyze digital evidence, including memory, system artifacts, and security logs, to determine incident scope, root cause, and potential impact. Maintain accurate chain-of-custody records and ensure forensic evidence is handled, documented, and preserved in accordance with established procedures. Perform forensic analysis of compromised systems to reconstruct attack timelines, identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), and determine attacker activities. Utilize forensic investigation tools and methodologies to support accurate and defensible technical findings. Incident Response & Threat Containment Lead technical response activities for major security incidents escalated by Level 2 and Level 3 SOC Analysts. Investigate security incidents to determine attack vectors, affected systems, potential exposure, and appropriate remediation actions. Coordinate technical containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident monitoring activities with relevant stakeholders. Conduct compromise assessments to identify indicators of intrusion, unauthorized access, and other suspicious activities across customer environments. Support root cause analysis and post-incident reviews to identify security weaknesses and recommend corrective measures. Malware Analysis & Threat Investigation Perform initial analysis and triage of malware, phishing emails, suspicious files, and exploit artifacts to identify malicious behavior and indicators of compromise. Analyze endpoint, network, and cloud security telemetry to identify attack patterns and potential threats. Investigate suspicious activities across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and other enterprise platforms. Collaborate with Cyber Threat Intelligence teams to incorporate relevant threat intelligence into investigations and response activities. Translate investigation findings into actionable recommendations to improve threat detection and response capabilities. Detection Engineering & Security Improvement Identify opportunities to improve security monitoring and detection capabilities based on forensic investigations and incident findings. Develop and recommend detection logic, including Sigma rules, indicators, and detection use cases, for implementation by Cybersecurity Engineering teams. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of incident response playbooks, forensic investigation procedures, and operational runbooks. Support the enhancement of Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) workflows to improve incident handling efficiency. Collaborate with SOC and Engineering teams to strengthen incident detection, investigation, and response processes. Customer Engagement, Reporting & Compliance Prepare comprehensive technical investigation reports outlining incident timelines, findings, root causes, impact assessments, and recommended remediation actions. Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, and response recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders. Provide clear and actionable guidance to support customer remediation and security improvement activities. Provide technical evidence and investigation findings to the Line Manager to support regulatory notifications, compliance requirements, and formal investigations. Support applicable Saudi Arabian cybersecurity and data protection requirements, including those of the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA), Saudi Central Bank (SAMA), and Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), where relevant. Maintain accurate case documentation and ensure investigations are completed in accordance with established operational procedures and service requirements. Our Culture & Code of Conduct: At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. We are looking for individuals who share these values and are committed to customer-centricity and ethical excellence. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from how we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in digital forensics, incident response, cybersecurity investigations, or a related field. Practical experience conducting forensic investigations and handling digital evidence using tools such as Velociraptor, KAPE, Volatility, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms. Strong understanding of digital forensic methodologies, evidence acquisition, preservation, analysis, and chain-of-custody requirements. Experience analyzing endpoint, server, network, and cloud security logs to investigate security incidents and identify malicious activities. Hands-on knowledge of security investigations involving Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID. Working knowledge of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms and security monitoring technologies. Experience using Python or PowerShell for scripting, investigation support, and task automation. Understanding of incident response methodologies, including identification, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis. Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical findings effectively. Fluency in written and spoken English. Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Preferred Certifications: GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, or GNFA. GCFR (SANS FOR509) for cloud forensics is a plus.

6695b0f13bfda3ab.description: The role You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience. This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next. Why this role One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership. Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters. An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it. A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match. What you will do Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them. Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work. Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering. Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression. Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it. Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand. Desired Candidate Profile Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it. A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product. A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc. Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

6631311f0d60be84.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME to join their team in Yanbu, Medina Province, Saudi Arabia. The role involves providing technical expertise for rotating equipment during Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), FMEA/FMECA, and various reliability studies. Role Purpose and Context The Rotating Equipment Mechanical Engineer – SME will support the identification of equipment functions, functional failures, failure modes, and failure mechanisms. This includes defining appropriate maintenance strategies aimed at improving reliability, availability, safety, and lifecycle performance of rotating equipment within the operational context. Key Responsibilities Act as the technical authority for rotating equipment during RCM, FMEA, and reliability workshops. Define and validate equipment functions, performance standards, and functional failures. Identify credible failure modes, failure mechanisms, and degradation processes for rotating equipment. Evaluate equipment failure consequences related to safety, environment, production, and maintenance costs. Review equipment history, bad actor reports, vibration data, oil analysis reports, and inspection findings. Recommend appropriate maintenance strategies, including Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM), Preventive Maintenance (PM), Failure Finding (FF), and Run-to-Failure (RTF). Assess maintenance intervals based on equipment criticality, failure characteristics, and operating context. Review OEM recommendations and industry best practices. Support Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) for recurring equipment failures. Validate maintenance tasks and spare-parts requirements generated from RCM studies. Identify reliability improvement opportunities and equipment design enhancements. Provide technical guidance on risk mitigation and equipment lifecycle management. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant and verifiable experience in a similar role. Candidates without previous RCM experience may be considered, but under the minimum gross salary. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the requirements are requested to submit their complete documents at the earliest. The application must be provided as ONE SINGLE PDF FILE, containing the updated CV, educational qualification certificates, relevant experience certificates, and a passport copy. Please ensure all submitted documents are clear, complete, and properly arranged within the PDF.

The role involves close collaboration with Destination Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Partnerships, Loyalty, Digital Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure marketing initiatives effectively reach target audiences and deliver measurable business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Support the development and execution of trade marketing strategies aligned with business and destination objectives. Plan and execute marketing activities across trade partners, distributors, travel operators, ticketing platforms, and promotional channels. Develop trade activation plans to drive demand generation, lead conversion, and visitation growth. Ensure marketing programs effectively support seasonal campaigns, destination launches, events, and new product offerings. Develop and execute integrated go-to-market plans for destination experiences, attractions, promotions, and new offerings. Coordinate cross-functional launch activities with Marketing, Commercial, Digital, Partnerships, and Operations teams. Develop and manage promotional campaigns, special offers, packages, and value-added propositions. Monitor promotion performance and recommend enhancements to maximize revenue and customer uptake. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to define and enhance destination, attraction, and entertainment propositions. Implement trade marketing programs designed to increase awareness, consideration, bookings, and visitation. Establish performance metrics and KPIs for trade marketing campaigns and activations. Go-to-Market Planning and Optimization This role involves developing and executing integrated go-to-market plans for various offerings, coordinating cross-functional launch activities, and supporting market segmentation to maximize campaign effectiveness. It also includes ensuring timely delivery of marketing assets and promotional content. Offer and Consumer Proposition Development The Assistant Manager will develop and manage promotional campaigns, special offers, and value-added propositions in close collaboration with commercial stakeholders. Responsibilities also include defining and enhancing destination and entertainment propositions, translating consumer insights into marketing messages, and ensuring alignment with target audience needs. It also involves building and maintaining relationships with internal stakeholders and external marketing partners, coordinating with tourism partners, and supporting co-marketing opportunities. Demonstrated experience in developing and executing go-to-market strategies and promotional campaigns. Experience managing marketing performance, conversion optimization, and ROI reporting. Experience within tourism, entertainment, hospitality, retail, travel, leisure, or destination marketing sectors is preferred.

66d53f25a32a62b1.description: About the Role SASREF is seeking a Cost Control Engineer to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role involves analyzing project requirements and specifications to determine associated costs, ensuring efficient and professional utilization of project budgets. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Control and monitor project total expenditure, including verifying invoices and claims from suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure all project expenditures are captured and recorded. Ensure effective project implementation and utilize reports from the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) within the project management system to monitor purchases, invoicing, and delivery until project closure. Coordinate with the project management team to resolve project issues and ensure timely project delivery and completion. Calculate and report accruals and capitalization costs to the Finance department. Ensure personal safety and well-being, and avoid actions that could jeopardize the safety of others. Comply with SASREF’s information security policies, including reporting suspicious emails and completing assigned cybersecurity awareness courses. 665bd45d22523b01.description: The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports KAUST's delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved KAUST procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Responsibilities Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Ensure compliance with SBC, NFPA, IFC, KAUST requirements, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Conduct fire risk assessments, inspections, system verification, and compliance checks, and recommend corrective actions. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Bachelor's degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in fire protection engineering, fire systems engineering, fire prevention, or fire & life safety compliance. Experience with fire protection system inspection, testing, commissioning, and compliance. Strong knowledge of SBC, NFPA, IFC, and preferably Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Experience reviewing fire protection designs, technical drawings, specifications, inspection reports, testing documents, and compliance records. Experience with deficiency management, corrective actions, and closeout. Experience working in complex environments such as universities, research facilities, industrial facilities, healthcare, mixed-use communities, or large campuses. Valid Saudi/GCC driver's license or valid driver's license as applicable. Fire safety/protection certifications such as CFPS, CFPE, CFAITMS, CWBSP, NICET, IFE, or equivalent are preferred.
